content.summary: Algoma Steel Group (NasdaqGM:ASTL) is forecasting impressive revenue growth of 19.8% per year, handily outpacing the broader US market's 10.3% annual rate. However, the company remains unprofitable, with losses increasing at a 58.9% annual clip over the past five years.
